title: Netflix Reveals the Trailer for 'The Final Problem'
body_markdown:
Entertainment


03 September 2026


Global


Spain


Link copied to clipboard


###


STARRING JOSE CORONADO, MARIBEL VERDÚ, MARÍA VALVERDE AND MARTIÑO RIVAS


[WATCH THE OFFICIAL TRAILER](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yLeja7kWgmU)


[DOWNLOAD THE NEW IMAGES](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/cfba1a5f-0e58-4137-aaa0-314b54c1158a)


Netflix today unveiled the official trailer and new images for


The Final Problem


, the limited series starring


Jose Coronado


(


The Truthers


,


The Snow Girl


),


María Valverde


(


Sounds Like Love


,


All We Cannot See)


,


Martiño Rivas


(


Snakes and Ladders


,


Cable Girls


) and


Maribel Verdú


(


Pan's Labyrinth


,


Elite


), among others. Based on the successful novel of the same name by acclaimed author


Arturo Pérez-Reverte


, the series premieres on Netflix on


September 25


.


This new miniseries, which combines thriller and mystery against an immersive period backdrop, consists of four episodes and features a first-rate ensemble cast, including


Gonzalo de Castro


(


Políticamente incorrectos


,


La ternura


),


Cristina Kovani


(


Muted, La caza: Guadiana)


,


José Condessa


(


Cacau, Turn of the Tide


) and


Pepón Nieto


(


Smiley


,


A Remarkable Tale )


, among others.


In the spring of 1959, thirteen people find themselves stranded by a violent storm on a small island off the coast of Mallorca. No one could imagine what is about to unfold at the secluded hotel where they are staying: Elisa Mander, a quiet English tourist, is found dead. What initially appears to be a suicide soon reveals itself to be something far more disturbing: a murder. Basil, a retired actor who once portrayed none other than Sherlock Holmes on the big screen, finds himself, almost unwittingly, tasked with uncovering the truth behind what happened.


In a place that no one can leave and no one can reach, every guest and employee becomes a suspect in a crime that, with each passing moment, proves to be far more complex and intricate than anyone could have initially imagined.


The Final Problem


is a sophisticated adaptation of one of


Arturo Pérez-Reverte’s


bestselling novels, a period thriller packed with secrets, mystery and unexpected twists. This new miniseries, which blends thriller and mystery against an immersive period backdrop, consists of four episodes.


The miniseries is produced by


Mod Producciones,


with


Fernando Bovaira


(


While at War, La Fortuna)


serving as producer,


Urko Errazquin


(


The Champion, Two Many Chefs)


as executive producer, and


Alberto Macías


,


Carlos Molinero


, and


Marisol Farré


as screenwriters. It is directed by Félix Viscarret (


Una vida no tan simple, Staring at Strangers ).


About Mod Producciones


MOD is a film and television production company founded in 2007 by Fernando Bovaira, with the aim of combining outstanding creative quality with strong commercial appeal. The company launched its production slate with films such as


Agora


, directed by Alejandro Amenábar—premiered at the Cannes Film Festival and the highest-grossing Spanish film of the year—and


Biutiful


, directed by Alejandro G. Iñárritu, which won the Best Actor Award at Cannes and received an Academy Award® nomination for Best Foreign Language Film. Since then, MOD has continued to produce critically acclaimed and commercially successful films, including


Cousinhood


, directed by Daniel Sánchez Arévalo;


I Can Quit Whenever I Want


, directed by Carlos Therón; and


While at War


, directed by Alejandro Amenábar. MOD has also established a strong presence in television with acclaimed series such as


Crematorium


, directed by Jorge Sánchez-Cabezudo, and


La Fortuna


, Alejandro Amenábar’s first television series. At the end of 2023, Prime Video successfully launched the ambitious original series


Los Farad


, directed by Mariano Barroso. In 2024,


The Blue Star


, the debut feature by Javier Macipe, was released in cinemas, while


The Champion


, directed by Carlos Therón, premiered on Netflix. Later that autumn,


Glimmers


, the third feature by director Pilar Palomero, was released. In 2025, MOD premiered


La buena letra


, an adaptation of Rafael Chirbes’ acclaimed novel directed by Celia Rico, and


The Captive


, Alejandro Amenábar’s latest feature. The company’s most recent releases in 2026 are


La Fiera


, directed by Salvador Calvo, and


Calle Málaga


, directed by Maryam Touzani. Upcoming releases include


El último mono


, a new comedy directed by Joaquín Mazón Lacasa and starring Juan Dávila and Susana Abaitua; and


Bunker


, an international co-production directed by Florian Zeller and starring Javier Bardem and Penélope Cruz.
